agenda: G3 of the generalization north star (02ca9432): out-of-distribution generalization over CONTROLLABLE boundary-condition factors, measured exactly on the procedurally-generated 2D conformal-Laplace suite (exact analytic labels; zero solver error).
problem: Dirichlet Laplace on conformally-deformed disks (problems/conformal_laplace.py): boundary = polygonal panels carrying a smooth Dirichlet trace (harmonic modes with k^-2 regularity); targets = exact interior potential.
train_distribution: drive modes 1-4, boundary_rms = 1.0, geometry deformation kappa <= 0.3, 256 training cases, n_boundary 128 / n_query 512

ood_axes.T0_in_range: fresh cases from the training distribution (control)
ood_axes.T2_bc_amplitude: boundary_rms in {2, 4} (the PDE is linear: exact extrapolation = linear scaling; MT1's drive-linearity contract should be EXACT here by construction, giving the ledger an exactness anchor)
ood_axes.T3_geometry: deformation kappa in (0.3, 0.6] (shapes beyond the training range)
ood_axes.each axis isolated: one factor moves per test set; 64 cases each

arms.mt2_bscalar: MeshTransformer2 + n_boundary_scalars=1 (the Dirichlet trace as an invariant seed feature), 2D embedded in 3D (z = 0 plane, in-plane normals, constant unit drive vector), out_vectors = 0
arms.softslice_2d: the suite's in-tree Transolver-class soft-slice baseline (the GeoTransolver mechanism family) at matched parameter count
arms.mt1_linear: the native MeshTransformer in drive-linear mode -- the contract-exactness reference for T2

protocol: identical optimizer/epochs across arms (small: minutes per run); 3 seeds per arm; matched parameter counts within 20%

deciding_readouts.G3_1: per-axis degradation ratio rel-L2(OOD axis) / rel-L2(T0), per architecture: the GENERALIZATION fingerprint. Curve/table dominance, not single numbers.
deciding_readouts.G3_2: T2 linearity: mt1_linear predicted EXACT (ratio 1.0 to machine precision, p ~ 0.85); the other two arms' T2 ratios measure what undeclared linearity costs
deciding_readouts.G3_3: any axis where mt2_bscalar beats softslice_2d by > 1.5x degradation ratio at equal T0 = the first measured architecture-driven BC generalization

launch_state.implementation_state: MT2 boundary-scalar channel implemented and contract-tested (13 tests); harness adapter delegated to a fresh-context subagent with this prereg as its brief
